papers.title: CtrlDiff: Training-Free Controllable Editing for Diffusion Image Generators
papers.title_zh: CtrlDiff：扩散图像生成器的免训练可控编辑
papers.abstract: We introduce a training-free attention reweighting mechanism that gives fine-grained control over layout, style, and subject identity in existing diffusion models. The method requires no fine-tuning or extra modules, works with any prompt-only API, and reduces editing artifacts by 43% on user studies.
papers.summary: 用免训练的重加权机制让现有扩散模型可精确控制布局与风格，可做成高级修图或设计素材批量风格化工具。

papers.title: Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation via Anatomical Prototype Memory
papers.title_zh: 基于解剖原型记忆的医学影像小样本分割
papers.abstract: We develop a few-shot segmentation framework with a prototypical memory bank that encodes anatomical priors, enabling accurate organ and lesion segmentation from only 5 annotated examples. Validation on CT and MRI datasets shows Dice improvements of 9-14 points over meta-learning baselines, with strong robustness to domain shift across scanners.
papers.summary: 用解剖原型记忆让仅 5 张标注就能训练医学影像分割模型，适合影像科辅助标注与基层筛查设备。
